messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — we need a 60m design review for the unified retry+fallback UX across API, SDK, and Console. Goal: align API surface, SDK helper behavior, and console fallback visualization. Pre-read will include API sketch, SDK shim, and console mockups. Proposed windows below.

calendar-bot: Proposed slots (auto): Wed Mar 15 16:00-17:00 PT, Thu Mar 16 09:00-10:00 PT, Fri Mar 17 11:00-12:00 PT. React with ✅ to pick.

sameer: ✅ Wed 16:00 PT works for me.

linh: Thu morning preferred (blocked Wed).

jordan: I can do Wed but need canary rollout plan ready — can we add 15m for rollout Q&A?

priya: I'll own the pre-read and checklist. Draft link: https://rwd.in/p/routing-retry-rfc (will update). Short checklist: 1) API surface contract, 2) SDK opt-in behavior, 3) Console wireframes + failure states, 4) perf/backpressure notes, 5) migration steps.

maria: @linh if Thu is the only option for you, we can move. @calendar-bot can you collect reactions until EOD?

calendar-bot: Collected 3 ✅ for Wed, 1 ✅ for Thu. Next step: confirm final time by 18:00 PT.

linh: Ok actually I can free Wed 16:00 PT if we keep it 60m. Will review mocks today.

jordan: Adding canary/rollback checklist snippet:
```
-canary: 5% traffic routing to new fallback
-monitor: p99 latency, error-rate
-rollback: automatic at >2x baseline error rate
```
We'll review in the slot.

priya: Pre-read checklist (short):
- API: sample request/response and error codes
- SDK: opt-in flag, default behavior, connection lifecycle
- Console: mockups for admin and end-user fallback
- Ops: required metrics, alert thresholds
Link to Google doc: https://rwd.in/doc/retry-pre-read (editable).

maria: Cool. I'll book Wed Mar 15 16:00-17:00 PT. Agenda draft:
- 5m intro
- 15m API surface
- 15m SDK behavior
- 15m Console UX
- 10m rollout/canary/ops
If anything else, ping here.

sameer: Sounds good. I'll add a short perf slide.

linh: I'll upload final mocks by EOD.

jordan: I'll draft the canary runbook and paste before meeting.

priya: Done — pre-read doc updated with mocks + API examples.

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup: Invite sent.
